_source: Sample error bodies from Plaid's public error pages (plaid.com/docs/errors/{item,institution,payment,api}/), fetched 2026-10-20, not the pinned 2026-09-28 docs capture. Verbatim: http status, error_type, error_message, display_message. Codes listed as Sandbox error passwords on plaid.com/docs/sandbox/test-credentials but absent here have no published sample: COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED, USER_SHOULD_VERIFY_DEPOSIT_ALLOCATIONS. ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED is here for /sandbox/item/reset_login; it is not a listed error password.

ACCESS_NOT_GRANTED.error_message: access to this product was not granted for the account
ACCESS_NOT_GRANTED.display_message: The user did not grant the necessary permissions for this product on their account.

INSTITUTION_NOT_RESPONDING.error_message: this institution is not currently responding to this request. please try again soon
INSTITUTION_NOT_RESPONDING.display_message: This financial institution is not currently responding to requests. We apologize for the inconvenience.

INSTITUTION_NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED.error_message: this institution is no longer supported
INSTITUTION_NO_LONGER_SUPPORTED.display_message: This financial institution is no longer supported. We apologize for the inconvenience.

INSTITUTION_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.error_message: not yet registered to create items for this institution
INSTITUTION_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.display_message: You must register your application with this institution before you can create items for it.

INSUFFICIENT_CREDENTIALS.error_message: insufficient authorization was provided to complete the request

INVALID_CREDENTIALS.error_message: the provided credentials were not correct
INVALID_CREDENTIALS.display_message: The provided credentials were not correct. Please try again.

INVALID_MFA.error_message: the provided MFA response(s) were not correct
INVALID_MFA.display_message: The provided MFA responses were not correct. Please try again.

INVALID_SEND_METHOD.error_message: the provided MFA send_method was invalid

ITEM_LOCKED.error_message: the account is locked. prompt the user to visit the institution's site and unlock their account
ITEM_LOCKED.display_message: The given account has been locked by the financial institution. Please visit your financial institution's website to unlock your account.

ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED.error_message: the login details of this item have changed (credentials, MFA, or required user action) and a user login is required to update this information. use Link's update mode to restore the item to a good state

ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED.error_message: this account is currently not supported
ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED.display_message: The given account is not currently supported for this financial institution. We apologize for the inconvenience.

MFA_NOT_SUPPORTED.error_message: this account requires a MFA type that we do not currently support for the institution
MFA_NOT_SUPPORTED.display_message: The multi-factor security features enabled on this account are not currently supported for this financial institution. We apologize for the inconvenience.

NO_ACCOUNTS.error_message: no valid accounts were found for this item
NO_ACCOUNTS.display_message: No valid accounts were found at the financial institution. Please visit your financial institution's website to confirm accounts are available.

PAYMENT_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.error_message: insufficient funds to complete the request
PAYMENT_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS.display_message: There isn't enough money in this account to complete the payment. Try again, or select another account or bank.

PAYMENT_INVALID_RECIPIENT.display_message: The payment recipient is invalid for the selected institution. Create a new payment with a different recipient.

PAYMENT_INVALID_REFERENCE.display_message: The payment reference is invalid for the selected institution. Create a new payment with a different reference.

PAYMENT_INVALID_SCHEDULE.display_message: The payment schedule is invalid for the selected institution. Create a new payment with a different schedule.

PAYMENT_REJECTED.display_message: The payment was rejected by the institution. Try again, or select another account or bank.

PAYMENT_SCHEME_NOT_SUPPORTED.display_message: The payment scheme is not supported by the institution. Either change scheme or select another institution.

UNAUTHORIZED_INSTITUTION.error_message: not authorized to create items for this institution
UNAUTHORIZED_INSTITUTION.display_message: You are not authorized to create items for this institution at this time.

USER_INPUT_TIMEOUT.display_message: The application timed out waiting for user input

USER_SETUP_REQUIRED.error_message: the account has not been fully set up. prompt the user to visit the issuing institution's site and finish the setup process
USER_SETUP_REQUIRED.display_message: The given account is not fully setup. Please visit your financial institution's website to setup your account.
